title: AIADMK complains to Arlekar over ‘inaction’ on its petitions on ‘horse trading’
description: Speaking to reports after meeting Arlekar, the party’s agricultural wing secretary and whip in the Assembly ‘Agri’ S.S. Krishnamurthy said there was no follow up to his party’s memorandum given to Assembly Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar
